description: This file implements a stub Vulkan HAL for Android, providing minimal functions to simulate Vulkan instance management without real hardware interaction.

methods.name: NoOp
methods.description: A function that logs a fatal error when called, indicating an invalid stub function.

methods.name: EnumerateInstanceExtensionProperties
methods.description: Returns zero extension properties, indicating no extensions are available.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Vulkan instance, managing a fixed maximum number of instances.

methods.name: DestroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys a Vulkan instance, marking it as unused.

methods.name: GetInstanceProcAddr
methods.description: Provides function pointers for Vulkan functions based on their name.
